independent_comparison.source: Neumann, Baumhoegger, Span, Vrabec and Thol (2021), Thermodynamic Properties of Methyl Diethanolamine, DOI 10.1007/s10765-021-02933-7, Eq.5 Table 8 manuscript pp.10-11
independent_comparison.limit: Independent EOS estimate, adjusted to liquid Cp and sound speed after Joback initialization; no measured ideal-gas Cp. Authors report Joback deviations up to 27% and cannot assign reliable ideal-Cp uncertainty.
